item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 31/Jul/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A hot southwesterly airstream will bring showers and thunderstorms to the coast of southern China tomorrow. With the southwesterly airstream becoming active and under the influence of the upper-air disturbances, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the coast of Guangdong during the weekend to early next week. An anticyclone aloft is expected to cover the coast of southern China in the middle and latter parts of next week. Showers will ease off gradually over the region. It will be very hot during the day. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Co-May will move across eastern China and gradually weaken today and tomorrow.
